title: Factory.ai
description: Factory.ai (Droid / Software Factory) integration for Port Ocean

configurations.name: factoryApiKey
configurations.description: Factory API key used to authenticate with the Factory Public API. Create one at https://app.factory.ai/settings/api-keys.

configurations.name: factoryApiHost
configurations.description: Base URL for the Factory Public API. Defaults to https://api.factory.ai.

actions.name: execute_droid
actions.description: Start a headless Factory Droid turn. Target an environment (fresh computer and session), an existing computer (new session), or an existing session (follow-up). With waitForCompletion true (default), the Port run stays open and the integration polls until the session is idle and an assistant message exists after the returned messageId. With waitForCompletion false, the Port run completes as soon as Factory accepts the turn, with sessionId, messageId, computerId, and app links in the output. Refreshes the session entity in the catalog when it is readable.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.title: Prompt
inputs.description: User message / instructions for the Droid turn

inputs.name: targetKind
inputs.title: Target kind
inputs.description: Where to run the turn: environment (provision a fresh computer from the environment's active build and start a session), computer (start a new session on an existing computer), or session (send a follow-up on an existing session).

inputs.name: environmentId
inputs.title: Environment ID
inputs.description: Required when targetKind is environment. Ignored (must be omitted) for computer and session targets.

inputs.name: computerId
inputs.title: Computer ID
inputs.description: Required when targetKind is computer. Ignored (must be omitted) for environment and session targets.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.title: Session ID
inputs.description: Required when targetKind is session. Ignored (must be omitted) for environment and computer targets. Concurrent execute_droid runs targeting the same sessionId are serialized.

inputs.name: model
inputs.title: Model
inputs.description: Optional model for a new session. Applies only when targetKind is environment or computer; ignored for session follow-ups.

inputs.name: reasoningEffort
inputs.title: Reasoning effort
inputs.description: Optional reasoning effort for a new session: none, dynamic, off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Applies only when targetKind is environment or computer; ignored for session follow-ups.

inputs.name: waitForCompletion
inputs.title: Wait for completion
inputs.description: When true (default), keep the Port run in progress and poll Factory until the turn finishes (session idle and an assistant message after messageId). When false, complete the Port run as soon as Factory accepts the turn.

actions.name: interrupt_session
actions.description: Stop the active agent loop on a running Factory Droid session and return the session execution status (idle, pending, or running). Idempotent when the session is already idle. Refreshes the session entity in the catalog when it is readable. Requires Factory Sessions API access (enabled for selected organizations only).

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.title: Session ID
inputs.description: Factory session to interrupt. Concurrent interrupt_session runs targeting the same sessionId are serialized.
